comparison.objective: Refit a loaded drawer on roller slides, close it, then pull-test it open.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load carrying, bilateral runner alignment, hook clearance, sliding, and controlled pull testing.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer must ride level and square on both slides, be closed hands-off, then left 30–80 mm open with its load retained.
comparison.reason: Large-part slide registration and pull testing are materially different from fine tool-guided latch release inside a connector cavity.
